open_questions_for_vendor: Please confirm the exact legal entity that contracts with Tavus for the Slack service — full legal name, legal form, and state/country of incorporation (we believe 'Slack Technologies, LLC', a Salesforce, Inc. subsidiary) — and provide the entity's registered office / principal place of business address.

Have you designated a representative in the EU under Article 27 GDPR (and in the UK under UK GDPR)? If yes, please provide the representative's name and full address; if the contracting structure instead runs through an EU-established Salesforce/Slack affiliate, please identify that entity and its address.

Have you formally appointed a Data Protection Officer? Your privacy policy references dpo@slack.com — please confirm this is the authoritative DPO contact entitled to respond to data-protection-related requests from customers (SAP requires a named channel), and provide the DPO's name and telephone number and/or email address.

Which certifications and audit reports does Slack currently hold for the service (SOC 2 Type II — period covered and Trust Service Criteria in scope; SOC 3; ISO 27001; ISO 27017; ISO 27018; ISO 27701; other)? Please provide the current SOC 2 Type II report and ISO certificates with scope statements (under NDA if required) so Tavus can place them on file.
What minimum TLS version (e.g. TLS 1.2, TLS 1.3) is enforced for data in transit to slack.com and api.slack.com endpoints?
Which encryption algorithm and key length are used for customer data at rest (messages, files, search indices, logs)?
Are backups encrypted, and with which algorithm? Are backup encryption keys managed the same way as production keys?

Who generates and manages the encryption keys for customer data at rest (Slack-managed platform keys vs. customer-held keys)? Please describe the Enterprise Key Management (EKM) offering, which plans it applies to, and confirm key handling for a workspace WITHOUT EKM (keys generated by Slack, not customer-specific?).
Can Slack, acting as a processor, anonymize and/or pseudonymize personal data in customer workspaces (e.g. on deactivation/offboarding or on customer instruction)? Please describe the capability.

Beyond encryption, which other technical safeguards protect customer data (access controls and least-privilege for Slack personnel, SSO/MFA, audit logging, network segmentation, penetration testing cadence, bug bounty program, DLP/eDiscovery interfaces)?

Does Slack offer EU data residency? If yes: which data categories does it cover (message/file content vs. profile data, metadata, logs, search indices), which plan tiers include it, and can it be enabled for an existing workspace?
Please provide your current sub-processor list for the Slack service (SAP requires the processing chain to Level 2, e.g. the underlying cloud provider(s)).
